description:
Get the full digital menu for one restaurant by slug (from search_restaurants), in a given language. Falls back to the restaurant's default language if the requested one isn't published yet.

Args:
  - slug (string, required): restaurant slug, e.g. "slainte-irish-pub"
  - language (string, optional): one of es, en, de, fr, it, pt, nl, pl, ru, ar, zh, hi, se, no — defaults to the restaurant's own default language

Returns: one or more menu tabs (sections with items, prices, allergens) plus restaurant contact info.
name: get_restaurant_menu
title: Get Restaurant Menu
